versions.changelog: Added visual assets (thumbnail, feature graphic, hero image). Enhanced documentation. Improved workflow templates.

Initial release of content-workflow-engine.

- Automates content creation, management, and distribution workflows for blogs, social media, newsletters, and more.
- Provides command-line tools to create, schedule, and run multi-stage content pipelines.
- Supports AI-powered ideation, writing, optimization, publishing, and analytics.
- Includes workflow templates for blogs, social media batches, and newsletters.
- Integrates with major publishing, social media, email, and analytics platforms.
